scope: Nine previously pending frozen Scryfall set-code product records: six distinct official Wizards-named special insert/Eternal subsets, two Clash Packs, and one Gideon Signature Spellbook. Code evidence grades differentiate explicitly published exact codes from family-only documentation.

records.source_section: Magic 2015 Clash Pack official announcement — two ready-to-play 60-card decks, six alternate-art foil cards
records.source_note: Wizards identifies the two-deck boxed Clash Pack format but does not print the Scryfall CP1 code here.

records.source_section: Fate Reforged official product page — Clash Pack with two preconstructed 60-card decks and six alternate-art foil cards
records.source_note: The official page lists the Japanese Clash Pack sale for January 30, 2015, distinct from frozen CP2 Scryfall earliest-card date January 23, 2015. Neither is silently overwritten.

records.source_section: Signature Spellbook: Gideon — eight fixed cards plus one foil; Wizards' own card gallery labels an included Rest in Peace printing SS2
records.source_note: SS2 appears explicitly on Wizards' product-card gallery print history, not as a three-letter product code on the general boxed product page. Card-version legality and complete boxed printing certification remain separate.

records.source_section: The Brothers' War booster guide TRANSFORMERS inserts — fifteen Transformers cards with their own set code BOT
records.source_note: The BOT cards appear as Universes Beyond inserts in The Brothers' War products, not as an independent premier booster set.

records.source_section: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan collecting guide — Jurassic World Collection explicitly carries set code REX
records.source_note: REX is a Jurassic World Collection booster insert and Bundle component, not another independent Ixalan premier set.

records.source_section: Marvel's Spider-Man collecting guide — Eternal-legal subset set codes SPE and MAR explicitly identified
records.source_note: SPE is the explicitly named Eternal-legal subset, not the SPM premier card-set code or a separate standalone expansion.

records.source_section: Avatar: The Last Airbender collecting guide — Eternal-legal card subset set code TLE explicitly identified
records.source_note: TLE's distinct Eternal-legal printing subset is not a standalone Avatar premier set.

records.source_section: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles collecting guide — Eternal-legal card subset set code TMC explicitly identified
records.source_note: TMC is a supplemental Eternal-legal card subset accompanying the parent release, not an additional premier expansion.

records.source_section: The Hobbit collecting guide — Eternal-legal card subset set code HOC explicitly identified
records.source_note: HOC is the independently coded supplemental Eternal-legal card subset, not a second Hobbit premier set.

caveats: Six insert/Eternal Scryfall codes are also expressly printed by Wizards; exact code confirmation does not turn any into a separately launched premier expansion.
SS2 is expressly named on a Wizards card-gallery printing index; the general boxed product page does not itself name SS2 as a product code.
CP2's Japanese marketed Clash Pack date is January 30 while the frozen Scryfall earliest-card date is January 23, 2015.
The Clash Pack products each include two playable decks, but those decks are parts of one marketed boxed release.
No live legality ruling, print-run count, individual card identity debut, or full packaged printing inventory is established by these family citations.
